name: bicycle recline walk
description: A relaxed walking-style pedal motion on a recumbent bike that builds leg endurance with the back well supported.
instructions: Sit on the recumbent bike and adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at full extension.
Place your feet on the pedals and hold the handles.
Pedal at an easy, walking-like pace.
Keep your back against the backrest and breathe steadily.
Cool down by slowing the pedalling gradually.
